digest.component_or_area: rebar LLM Bedrock provider and capability layer
propositions: Add a first-class native AWS Bedrock provider that constructs pydantic-ai's BedrockConverseModel via the ambient AWS credential chain, avoiding the OpenAI-compatible gateway proxy.

Bedrock prompt caching must set exactly two keys (bedrock_cache_instructions and bedrock_cache_tool_definitions) for parity with the direct-Anthropic path, deliberately excluding bedrock_cache_messages.
Bedrock caching is model-dependent and can fail silently, billing full input tokens with no error, so rebar must WARN when caching was requested but both cache_read and cache_write counters are zero.

temperature is fatal (400 ValidationException) on some Bedrock models, breaking Pass-2 verifiers that send temperature=0, so a supports_temperature capability keyed on exact model id must omit it while retaining it for measured-good defaults.

A provider-agnostic failure translator must convert a 400/ValidationException naming a sampling parameter plus a rejection word into an LLMConfigError with remedies, without introducing a provider-name branch.

Bedrock support ships as an optional [bedrock] extra kept out of the default [agents] install but added to dev so CI tests run, and the live cache canary must live under tests/external/ so default CI makes no billable AWS calls.
